analysis_method.test_declarations: Static regex of Go func Test declarations followed by source reading of explicit t.Run arguments. No Go/AST/list or test execution.
analysis_method.child_names: Literal/finite-loop/map source expansion with ASCII whitespace normalized to underscore. One slash-bearing t.Run is one named leaf; no fabricated intermediate parents. Map execution order is not an asserted contract.
analysis_method.function_hashes: Exact UTF-8 bytes from a gofmt top-level func declaration through its first column-zero closing-brace line, including that newline. Start/end lines and byte length recorded.
analysis_method.query_hashes: Exact named SQL marker/comments/statement bytes through the final semicolon line before the next named marker, including that newline. No SQL parsed or executed.
analysis_method.file_hashes: Raw complete-file SHA256. Manifest is sorted file + tab + sha256 + newline; this is a bounded read manifest, not the full frozen-source manifest.
analysis_method.selector_hash: SHA256 of exact selector UTF-8 bytes without a trailing newline.

fences.contract: LockManagedRuntime delegates false. Canonical positive reclaim still uses exclusive password user, namespace, current runtime/binding and installation admission before task locks; no shared-mode/public flag or singular rewrite.

Only a reliable necessary-condition negative may skip Step2. True/unknown/error must follow the separately admitted canonical/error policy. Probe is read-only and non-authorizing; it must not call lock_issue_execution or return private rows.

Any due runtime still triggers complete uniqueIDs canonical work when potential rows exist. Nil/failed cache remains conservative; retain retry/backstop schedule and do not forget due hints for a skipped/locked positive candidate.

fences.contract: Do not return the whole method early after a negative reclaim probe. Continue original cache version sampling, queued candidates, per-agent claims, routing, cap and same-call deferred promotion events.

Potential predicate must be a conservative superset using the DB clock and necessary dispatched/never-started/recovery/expired-or-absent lease predicates. Canonical UPDATE remains unchanged; active lease/young dispatch/started task never becomes an authorized reclaim.

Previously admitted stopped recovery keeps original binding/epoch/admission. Unknown history is never backfilled. Real reclaim advances generation and finalization/receipt/requeue CAS continue to reject older delivery.
Return genuinely committed earlier claims/reclaims when a later candidate/agent claim fails; never convert that partial success to an empty failure.
Retained same-namespace reservation still blocks ordinary queued work until proof. Preserve ordinary source/triage/lock_issue_execution admission; a pure negative precheck grants no execution.

Service profile allocation alone does not admit handler/router execution. Retain unchanged adapter/source/finalization bindings and R30 2PASS/1FAIL/1NOT_RUN,retry0; do not claim new R4/native/full S2 acceptance.

caveats_not_found: All counts are static source-derived inventories, not PASS results. No Go/AST/test-list/TestMain/SQL/DB/Redis/API/browser/runtime/signals/Git/dependency or agent operation was executed.

The original batch test file has exactly five top-level tests. DB-only batch originals total six across the main/partial/deferred files. Primary original union is 16/27/24, not an estimate based on a sixth nonexistent main-file test.

newRedisTestClient reads REDIS_TEST_URL, forces DB12, Ping/FlushDB and cleanup FlushDB/Close; unset/unreachable endpoints skip. Dedicated task-owned Redis is required for conditional external controls. Never export a global endpoint or reset foreign Redis.

TestReclaimCheckCache_RedisFailureFallsBackToEveryRuntime closes a 127.0.0.1:0 client before use and belongs in the no-external-Redis union. TestEmptyClaimCache_EmptyRuntimeIDIsNoOp uses the external helper despite its name.

newTaskClaimRacePool still falls back to an implicit local database and skips on parse/Ping failure. ROOT must load the recorded explicit owned DB/profile and reject SKIP; no environment or fixture edits were made here.
Singular managed-history and revoked-claim controls protect shared source/provenance defaults; they do not establish that a batch-only optimization fixes singular idle polls.

No existing standalone necessary-condition EXISTS or named probe-error/negative-clock regression was found in the frozen bounded source. Any new probe needs ROOT-reviewed true/false/error and clock-boundary tests appropriate to the admitted behavior; proposed names are not invented as originals.
No direct batch router test was found in the bounded source inventory. The listed router top covers managed enrollment/provenance/recovery, while direct HTTP batch coverage lives in handler tests.
No fresh full116/handler99/router54, R4/native diagnosis, original browser retry, deadline adjustment or successful-completion replay is justified by this static inventory alone.
